stories.title: AI-powered bionic eye breakthrough could help the blind see again
stories.synopsis: Scientists have used AI to make experimental bionic vision technology more precise, helping predict the flashes and shapes of light perceived by a blind man with a brain implant. For people who lost their sight to an inherited eye disease or an accident, it brings the hope of seeing again one step closer.

stories.title: Using AI to map disaster damage for faster rescue and recovery
stories.synopsis: Texas A&M's CLARKE system can assess up to 2,000 homes in seven minutes, even without an internet connection after a drone lands. Researchers estimate it could help emergency managers make decisions roughly a day earlier so help reaches the hardest-hit areas first. It is already part of the standard operating procedure for Florida's disaster drone team.

stories.title: New research could lead to faster, trustworthy AI models for climate prediction
stories.synopsis: MIT researchers have developed a technique for building fast, trustworthy and adaptable AI climate emulators using only a fraction of the data typically required. These models can run in just a few seconds, which lets scientists explore many future climate scenarios quickly. The team hopes the work will make such tools more useful for policy decisions.
